subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw allow owner-scoped live QMD session transcript hits to synthesize a same-agent session key when the combined session store has no entry, while leaving broader private conversation recall to the default-off product setting?
rationale: The remaining bug sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and the active choices trade off narrow runtime repair, broader product UX, and fail-closed privacy behavior.

options.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
options.body: Accept the owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep cross-agent and sandbox-denied hits fail-closed, and handle automatic private recall separately.

options.title: Fold into broader private recall
options.body: Pause the narrow bug fix and resolve this only through the remember-across-conversations product surface once the broader PR is clean.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Require live transcript hits to have a session-store entry and close the remaining recall gap as an intentional privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep cross-agent and sandbox-denied hits fail-closed, and handle automatic private recall separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the overlapping maintainer product direction and broad recall PR, so they are best placed to decide the privacy boundary.
